metadata.case_name: SIU KWAI HUNG v. NATIONAL FORTUNE INVESTMENT LTD. AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: prolapsed intervertebral disc of L4/L5 (lumbar spine)
source: a myelogram was carried out. It showed an anterior indentation at L4/L5 compatible with prolapsed intervertebral disc with radiculopathy.
Dr Yeung in his medical report stated that the plaintiff had ... prolapsed disc of L4 to L5 level.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: fracture of left os calcis (left heel / calcaneus)
source: X-ray examination showed a small translucent area at the posterior half of the left os calcis.
Dr Yeung in his medical report stated that the plaintiff had a fracture of left Os calcis

manifestations.description: persistent pain and tenderness over the left heel
tenderness at the posterior talo-fibula fragment
pain and paresthesia over the anterior aspects of both thighs
limited ability to walk (cannot walk for longer than 10 minutes)
legs are feeble; cannot stand or walk for too long

treatments_received: Emergency and Accident Department examination and injection and medicine
treatments_future: operative excision of the inflammated plantar fascia (if conservative treatment fails)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities arising from injuries to his back and left heel (award made: HK$235,000).

comparable_cases.case_name: Chun Yat Nam v. Attorney General for and on behalf of the Commissioner of Police
comparable_cases.injury_description: for injuries within the serious injury category, the award was between $250,000 and $335,000 (in December 1994).
